texts.facts: It is submitted that the issue involved in the present application is covered by the said judgment.
texts.arguments: It is also submitted by Shri R. L. Khapre, learned Senior Advocate that from the averments in the FIR, ingredients of the offence alleged against the applicants are not fulfilled. The non-applicant no. 1 has filed reply and submitted that registration of the FIR under Section 328 of the IPC cannot be faulted, as the material on record fulfills ingredients of Section 328 of the IPC. Shri T. A. Mirza, learned A.P.P. invited our attention to the judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Maharashtra Vs. Sayyed Hassan Sayyed Subhan and ors. [2018 AIR (SC) 5348] and submitted that it is open for the Food Safety Officer to independently filed complaint before the Competent Court for the offence under provision of the Act of 2006. The learned A.P.P. further submitted that the investigation in all the matters is completed and charge-sheets are ready. He also invited attention of this Court to the order passed by the Division Bench of this Court in LD-VC-CRI-APPLICATION (APPA) No. 452/2020 in the case of Ritesh Rajkumar Toshniwal Vs. State of 27 cr-apl-444-14j+45.odt Maharashtra (one of us Justice Z. A. Haq is a party) and submitted that similar order be passed in the present applications as facts of these batch of applications are similar.
